mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_t (s_id, m_name, m_price, m_active) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{name}, #{price}, true)
mapper.select: SELECT m_id AS menuId, s_id AS storeId, m_name AS name, m_price AS price FROM menu_t WHERE m_id = #{menuId} AND m_active = true
SELECT m_id AS menuId, s_id AS storeId, m_name AS name, m_price AS price, m_active AS active FROM menu_t WHERE s_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY m_id
